authority.lock_procedure: After SV1 review, SV3 writes a lock and run authorization binding this protocol, the attack code and the evaluated checkpoints; the week 11 trial needs that lock, the official evaluation a later locked version

threat_model.adversary: Honest-but-curious edge (KV260): follows the protocol, keeps everything it receives and tries to reconstruct the ECG or re-identify the patient
threat_model.observes: Exactly the tensor the edge receives at split s: INT8 per-channel values plus FP16 scales (registry v2 quantization), with the learned noise for rho2
threat_model.knows: Architecture, tail weights, protection algorithm and its parameters (lambda, noise distribution), and auxiliary data from the same distribution
threat_model.eavesdropper: Handled by BLE LE Secure Connections (AES-CCM in nRF52840 hardware), enabled for every method in the final experiment; Pi is not computed for the eavesdropper
out_of_scope: an actively malicious edge that deviates from the protocol
inference of sex or age (too few patients)
threat_model.P1: Removed from the action set: before the edge Pi(s, P1) = Pi(s, P0); kept as an implemented, measured mechanism discussed in 2-3 sentences

attacks.A1: Basic decoder trained with MSE to map the observed tensor back to the 360-sample ECG window
attacks.A2: GAN decoder: A1 plus a discriminator
attacks.A3: Adaptive attacker: A2 retrained on protected tensors, knowing the full algorithm and protection parameters
attacks.B_naive: Re-identification classifier trained on rho0 tensors at the same s
attacks.B_adaptive: Re-identification classifier trained on the protected tensors, knowing algorithm, lambda and noise distribution
attacks.B_rec: Re-identification classifier applied to signals reconstructed by A3
attacks.naming: Paper text: three reconstruction attacks of increasing strength (A1-A3) and one re-identification attack (B); roadmap 8.1 -> A1, A2; 8.2 -> B; 8.3 -> A3 (+ B-adaptive)

privacy_metric.Pi: Pi(s, rho) = 1 - Adv, Adv = (bacc - 1/N) / (1 - 1/N), clipped to [0, 1]
privacy_metric.bacc: Balanced accuracy of per-beat top-1 re-identification on the test part: mean over the N patients of per-patient recall (SV1 2026-11-05 replaces plain accuracy; always-majority already gives 6.6 % on DS1 against 1/22 = 4.5 %)
privacy_metric.strongest_attack: Adv is the maximum over B-naive, B-adaptive and B-rec available for that (s, rho)
privacy_metric.reconstruction_metrics: NRMSE, Pearson correlation and R-peak position error of A1-A3 are reported in the attack table and gallery, not combined into Pi
privacy_metric.confidence_interval: OPEN: plain-accuracy Wilson no longer applies to bacc; candidate = patient-stratified bootstrap over test beats, 2000 resamples, seed 20261105, percentile 95 % interval of bacc mapped to Pi
privacy_metric.session_variant: Majority vote over 10 consecutive beats reported in the discussion only

trial_week11.time_split: Per record: drop beats whose R peak lies within 30 s (10800 samples) of sample 325000; earlier beats -> attacker side, later beats -> test
trial_week11.attacker_validation: Last 20 % (by time) of each record's attacker side
trial_week11.counts_checked_by_SV3: 50995 DS1 beats; 1681 dropped; attacker side 767-1637 and test 799-1613 beats per record; largest patient 6.59 % of beats
trial_week11.decoder_training_data: Attacker side of the 22 DS1 records
trial_week11.caveat: DS1 patients were in the training of the model, so trial numbers are an early warning only and never enter the paper's main numbers

official.identities: DS2; OPEN: N = 21 (without 202, SV1 2026-11-03 item 10) or N = 22 (SV1 2026-11-05 point 4 wording); asked to SV1
official.rule: DS2 is used only for privacy evaluation; never to choose lambda, noise, checkpoint or threshold; protection parameters are locked on validation before the first Pi on DS2

trial_week11_scope.rho0: Package A checkpoint (fcf3f846...) at s2, s4, s5, s8
trial_week11_scope.rho1: NoPeek candidates (selected lambda, deployment seed) at s2, s4, s5 from the NoPeek v1 grid
trial_week11_scope.rho2: Candidate at s2 if ready; at the latest early week 12
questions: (i) Does Pi(s, rho0) increase with s?
(ii) Does rho1 raise Pi at s2 clearly?
trial_week11_scope.report: Report to SV1 the same day the numbers exist

predeclared_branches_after_trial.main: s2 fails Pi_min at rho0 and passes at rho1 or rho2: main scenario, N2 leads
predeclared_branches_after_trial.s2_passes_at_rho0: Keep Pi_min = 0.5; use the Pi_min sweep to find the range where protection matters
predeclared_branches_after_trial.no_signal: Pi does not increase with s, or neither rho1 nor rho2 raises Pi: SV1 decides the T4 pivot in week 12
predeclared_branches_after_trial.middle_cut: Consider rho in {rho0, rho1}. If s4 has a rho reaching Pi_min, use s4; else if s5 has one, use s5; else use s4 and consider rho2 (SV1 6a)

attack_models_candidate.status: OPEN for SV1: architectures and budgets are candidates, fixed before the lock
attack_models_candidate.B_classifier: NCL input: two Conv1d(64, kernel 5)+ReLU+MaxPool blocks, global average pooling, Linear(N); NC input (s9, s10): MLP 128-ReLU-N. AdamW lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, batch 256, at most 50 epochs, early stop on attacker-validation bacc with patience 5, CE weighted by inverse patient frequency, 3 seeds
attack_models_candidate.A1_decoder: Mirror of the head: ConvTranspose/upsampling back to [1, 360]; MSE; AdamW lr 1e-3, batch 256, at most 50 epochs, early stop on attacker-validation MSE with patience 5; 1 seed in the trial
attack_models_candidate.input: Dequantized tensor (INT8 x FP16 scale) as the edge sees it

limitations: Small number of identities (N = 21 or 22); PTB-XL left for later
Trial on DS1 patients seen in training
